project.name: Springfield (Fife)
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: The village remains selector-only because private ruins and route scenery are not converted into a town attraction cluster. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. Private Crawford Priory ruins are not represented as a public See attraction. Small Muir Road/on-street parking guidance is kept in the route notes rather than pinned as a guaranteed car park. No current café or public toilet was verified.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Springfield is a useful rail-accessible start for the Crawford Priory and Pitlessie walk, but the route alone does not make the village a 60+ destination.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Verified outdoor routes can suit responsible dog visits, with close control around livestock, roads, wildlife and historic fabric.
